name: Suppliers
_about: Per-supplier settings of the spec (01 Database section 3, Control Panel CP-R9). A shipment with no quoted lead time uses its supplier's default production days, then the global setting.

fields.name: Is_Main_Supplier
fields.label: Main Supplier
fields.helpText: Fenteng, Tony Fan: the supplier ladder day-3 decision also goes to the supervisor.

fields.name: Name_Aliases
fields.label: Other Names
fields.helpText: The names this supplier is called in older records, separated by commas (e.g. Tony, Tony Fan Lighting). A supplier is found by its name or one of these, never by a part of a name (spec INQ-R6).
